messages:
tara: FYI: were flipping on the On-Prem Audit Readiness bundle for Private customers tomorrow 0900 PT. This includes the evidence-export tool + auditor token workflow. Please skim and ACK.

ben: Link? Any admin flags we need to set?

tara: Release doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/onprem-audit-bundle. Admin flag `enable_onprem_audit` (false by default).

mike-sre: Default auditor token TTL is 8h, scoped to read-only endpoints. We also rotate tokens on creation. Will add RBAC checks.

olivia-sales: Heads-up for AE team: customers may ask about pricing for auditor access. Recommend we position it as a paid support add-on. I'll draft suggested phrasing.

legal: Legal note: attestations + signed permission required before generating full traces. Redacted exports OK by default. Use our standard auditor NDA.

ben: Any breaking changes to existing webhooks?

tara: No breaking changes. Evidence export uses the new `/admin/export_audit_bundle` endpoint and writes to `s3://private-evidence/<cust>/`. See doc for example curl.

mike-sre: Smoke test command:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN>" \ 
  https://staging-onprem.redwood.local/admin/export_audit_bundle?customer=foo
```
Bundle appears under `s3://private-evidence/foo/` with manifest.json.

olivia-sales: ACK - will share messaging.

ben: ACK - will flip flag on staging and run tests.

mike-sre: ACK - infra prepped, monitoring alerts in place.

tara: Thanks all. Well announce GA to customers in the morning after deploy. If anything blocks, reply here. :rocket:
